workflow.name: Upgrade with a failure branch
workflow.description: Upgrade a dependency; on failure a read-only stage diagnoses it instead of failing the run; a notice runs on either path.

prompts.label: upgrade
prompts.text: Upgrade {{variables.package_name}} to {{variables.version}}, fix the breaking changes and run the tests. Stop if the tests still fail.

prompts.label: summary
prompts.text: Summarize what changed in the upgrade of {{variables.package_name}}.

prompts.label: diagnose
prompts.text: The upgrade of {{variables.package_name}} failed (status {{stages.upgrade.status}}). Explain the most likely cause and what a person should try next.

prompts.label: notice
prompts.text: Write a three-line notice for the team about the upgrade of {{variables.package_name}}, from the result you were given.
